excluded: all raw files not referenced by the two ABBA logs

metadata.aggregation: Two ABBA repeats are averaged per seed/model. Mean and sample standard deviation (n-1) are computed across the three training seeds.
metadata.accuracy_policy: ABBA repeats are repeated measurements of the same trained checkpoint and are not treated as independent training runs. No n=6 accuracy standard deviation is reported.
missing_data: 320 px stratified small-object recall: no existing full analysis file; not imputed and no new inference run

limitations: Size groups are tertiles of GT bbox area in original image pixels; the thresholds are dataset-specific and do not transfer directly to other camera resolutions or viewpoints.

Groups are not class-stratified. Overall GT counts are prohibitory=143, danger=61, mandatory=24; class composition differs by group, so size-group recall differences may be confounded by class effects.

Small-sample cells (<30 GT boxes): small/danger=14, small/mandatory=7, medium/danger=13, medium/mandatory=8, large/mandatory=9. The rarest class is mandatory (24 GT boxes); confidence intervals are wide and no significance test is performed.
The 227-image test split comes from video-derived GTSDB data; near-duplicate frames reduce the effective number of independent samples.
Matching uses one operating point (confidence >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.50); recall rankings can change at other thresholds.
Each model is evaluated in one deterministic pass; quantization calibration uncertainty and repeated-run variance are not estimated.
Only three training seeds are compared, so seed-level variation limits strong conclusions about INT8 degradation.

small_object_analysis.note: Stratified small-object recall is computed from existing full analysis files only; no new inference was run. Missing resolutions are reported, not imputed.

warnings: Only three training seeds are available; sample standard deviations are based on n=3 and are sensitive to individual seeds.
The 640 px and 320 px results come from separately trained checkpoints, so the resolution effect combines training resolution with inference resolution; it is not a pure input-size ablation.
The benchmark host is recorded as Raspberry Pi 5 in raw metadata; hardware identity was not independently re-verified here.
All accuracy values refer to one fixed 227-image test split; no cross-dataset generalization claim is made.
